data.body: Historical audit of incremental re-review (lever: carry forward per-criterion verdicts): REJECTED by the data. 894 BLOCK→re-review transitions: 37% block on ≥1 criterion NOT in the original block (18% entirely-new criteria); the most common new criteria (G1G2, G6, E4, COH, E6) are cross-cutting whole-plan criteria that a changed-sections-only design would carry forward. Control: same-material re-runs produce 0% all-new-criteria blocks (15% mixed = nondeterminism floor), so new-criteria blocks on revised material are real revision-induced defects. Skipping unchanged criteria would have missed blocking findings in ~2 of 5 re-reviews. Companion finding: 307/1,457 full-LLM re-reviews (21%) ran on IDENTICAL material fingerprints — 171 triggered by base-sha drift alone — the cleanest remaining quality-neutral savings target. Analysis script + output in reports/llm-gate-cost-2026-08-11/round2/.
